scripts.build: npm run gen:types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build
scripts.gen:types: json2ts --input ../schema/run.schema.json --output src/types.ts --additionalProperties false --bannerComment "/* GENERATED from ../schema/run.schema.json by npm run gen:types. Do not edit. */"
scripts.gen:types:check: npm run gen:types && git diff --exit-code src/types.ts
